detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

GLP-1 (C/S) — Metabolic Peptide Blend
PEPTIDE RESEARCH COMPOUND

Chemical Information

Components
This product is a defined blended research peptide preparation consisting of two synthetic metabolic peptide analogs:

1. GLP-1 (C)
  • Peptide Class: Amylin analog
  • Typical Peptide Length: ~37 amino acids
  • Nominal Content: 5 mg (per vial)
  • Verified Net Content: 5.64 mg (LC-MS/MS)
  • Reference Molecular Weight: ~3,900–4,000 g/mol
  • Reference Molecular Formula:
    C₁₉₄H₃₁₂N₅₄O₅₉S₂ (representative peptide backbone; exact elemental composition may vary depending on lipidation, linker chemistry, and salt form)
2. GLP-1 (S)
  • Peptide Class: GLP-1 receptor analog
  • Peptide Length: 31 amino acids
  • Nominal Content: 5 mg (per vial)
  • Verified Net Content: 4.56 mg (LC-MS/MS)
  • Reference Molecular Weight: ~4,113 g/mol
  • Reference Molecular Formula:
    C₁₈₇H₂₉₁N₄₅O₅₉ (representative lipidated GLP-1 analog; exact composition may vary depending on linker chemistry and salt form)
Product Description

This laboratory research peptide blend is composed of GLP-1 (C) and GLP-1 (S). The blend is intended for controlled in-vitro research environments where researchers examine the combined physicochemical behavior, analytical characteristics, and co-formulation properties of two distinct peptide analog classes.

Independent third-party analysis confirms:

  • component identity by LC-MS/MS
  • high purity
  • measured net peptide content for each component

This preparation is supplied as a lyophilized powder blend for analytical and experimental laboratory research only.

No clinical, diagnostic, or therapeutic interpretation is intended or permitted.

Product Designation Note:

This product is identified using an internal designation for cataloging and differentiation purposes. It is not marketed, labeled, or represented as any approved pharmaceutical or therapeutic compound.

Research Applications:

This peptide blend may be used in controlled laboratory settings for:

  • physicochemical characterization of blended peptide systems
  • peptide–peptide co-formulation compatibility studies
  • physicochemical stability and degradation pathway analysis
  • chromatographic and spectrometric characterization
  • exploratory in-vitro assessment of blended peptide systems
Storage and Handling:
  • Store the lyophilized powder at -20°C.
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2-8°C and use promptly.
  • Maintain aseptic handling practices to ensure product quality and sterility.
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice

GLP-1 (C/S) is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
